assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 16-bit pixel-art sprite atlas for a gothic occult first-person game SIGIL BREACH. ROW ONE four frames of the SAME small burning incense brazier: antique brass bowl on a short black stand, orange-yellow flame dancing left/up/right/down in four distinct animation phases, smoke wisps charcoal and grey. Orthographic front three-quarter view, consistent light from upper left, all complete assets fit their cells; genuinely transparent background, no floor plane or shadows, no checkerboard, no text, exact 4x2 grid.

Edit this exact 4x4 animation sprite sheet. Keep its size, alpha background, exact 4x4 layout, all character designs, colors, scale, all other cells and all poses unchanged.
